analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past two sessions. While the RSI has exited oversold territory, it remains in the neutral zone. The trading volume ratio of 0.74 relative to the 5-day average dampens the reliability of current movements. Therefore, further directional confirmation is required.
